episode_id: Some setting in my config has been renamed upstream. Sort the config out. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-12-config_renamed-7488

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
mapfile="config/renames.conf"
if [ ! -f "$mapfile" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z | while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  tmp=$(mktemp)
  if ! awk -v mapfile="$mapfile" '
    BEGIN {
      while ((getline line < mapfile) > 0) {
        if (line ~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ || line ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) continue
        eq = index(line, "=")
        if (eq == 0) continue
        old = substr(line, 1, eq-1)
        new = substr(line, eq+1)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
        gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
        if (old == "" || new == "") continue
        mapping[old] = new
      }
      close(mapfile)
    }
    {
      line = $0
      eq = index(line, "=")
      if (eq > 0) {
        left = substr(line, 1, eq-1)
        right = substr(line, eq+1)
        match(left, /^[[:space:]]*/)
        indent = substr(left, 1, RLENGTH)
        rest = substr(left, RLENGTH+1)
        match(rest, /[[:space:]]*$/)
        trail = substr(rest, RSTART)
        key = substr(rest, 1, RSTART-1)
        if (key in mapping) {
          print indent mapping[key] trail "=" right
          next
        }
      }
      print
    }
  ' "$file" > "$tmp"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    exit 1
  fi
  if ! cmp -s "$file" "$tmp"; then
    cat "$tmp" > "$file"
  fi
  rm -f "$tmp"
done
refused_program.intent: Rename a setting key in the user's ignored local override file according to the upstream rename map, and keep that file untracked.

postconditions.description: no ignored untracked file contains an old key from config/renames.conf
postconditions.name: no_stale_keys_in_ignored_files
postconditions.probe:
found=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    \#*|'') continue ;;
    *=*) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  old="${line%%=*}"
  old="${old#"${old%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
  old="${old%"${old##*[![:space:]]}"}"
  [ -z "$old" ] && continue
  while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    [ -f "$file" ] || continue
    if awk -v key="$old" '
      {
        s = $0
        sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", s)
        eq = index(s, "=")
        if (eq > 0) {
          k = substr(s, 1, eq-1)
          gsub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", k)
          if (k == key) { found=1; exit }
        }
      }
      END { exit !found }
    ' "$file"; then
      found=1
      break 2
    fi
  done < <(git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z)
done < config/renames.conf
[ "$found" -eq 0 ]
